special_rules: Long-term rates: 0% if taxable income ≤ $47,025 (single); 15% up to $518,900; 20% above
Net Investment Income Tax (NIIT): additional 3.8% on investment income for high earners (AGI >$200k single)
Wash-sale rule: cannot deduct a loss if you buy the same security within 30 days
Each disposal (sale, swap, or use to pay for goods) is a taxable event
Crypto-to-crypto swaps are taxable — not just USD conversions
Wash-sale rule does NOT currently apply to crypto (legislative proposals pending)
Mining/staking rewards taxed as ordinary income at receipt; then CGT on disposal
Form 1099-DA required from brokers from 2025 onwards
Primary residence exclusion: $250,000 single / $500,000 married if owned+occupied 2 of last 5 years
1031 Exchange: defer CGT by reinvesting proceeds into like-kind property
Opportunity Zone investments: potential CGT deferral and exclusion

notes: Federal rates only. State income tax applies additionally (0% in TX/FL/NV to 13.3% in CA). Consult a CPA for state-specific treatment.
